description: This file defines functionality related to managing placeholder states for internationalization (i18n), including tracking used placeholders and generating new ones.

classes.name: PlaceholderState
classes.description: A struct that maintains a counter and a set of used placeholder strings for i18n purposes.

methods.name: NewPlaceholderState
methods.description: Constructor function that initializes a PlaceholderState with used placeholders detected in the input text.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Method that generates and returns a new unique placeholder string not used before.
